_comment: Sites where an error code is deliberately unpacked to a number, and why the ordinal has to cross there. configure/check_error_ordinals.py fails the configure on an entry that no longer matches the file it names, so an exemption cannot outlive the site it was written for. Everything else formats the code: Log("... {}", res.error()) prints its two words, and IErrorRegistry::Describe (Zahlen/COM/IErrorRegistry.hpp) resolves it to category/name/message text.
